direction_basis: G_X_NEG governed winding shell stress in all 7 non-single-span reviewed P36 models. X lateral governed 6/7 of those. Fixed representative direction; not an envelope of all wind directions.
iteration_order: BASELINE reviewed -> targets from these three cases -> REPEAT reviewed/HOLD -> AB_SHIFT reviewed/HOLD -> next configuration. Full-orbit configurations first.
target_rule: Top 3 panels by maximum native shell principal stress across G/L_X_NEG/G_X_NEG. In each panel repeat two distinct case-governing native spans, or two passes on the same span if only one governs.
contact_contract: Old contact contract retained. Additional winding and actual additional self-weight only. No added sleeve links, supports, or contacts. AB uses original A/B index cycles with step=shift and only existing baseline sleeve contacts.
legacy_result_reuse: Only exact same configuration and selected native case subset, after generated input physical equivalence checks; candidate targets must match before any reuse.
output_policy: All three cases per valid model: global and panel extrema, native hotspot IDs, reactions, frozen GH, input hashes and compressed per-element native fields. HOLD retains evidence and reason. No capacity PASS claim.
